query: A soft elastic ball bounces on the ground.
Create a soft elastic cube sitting on a flat surface, then drop a rigid sphere onto it from above. The cube should visibly deform under the impact.
Build a scene with a soft elastic beam fixed at one end and free at the other. Release it and let it oscillate under gravity while a second soft elastic sphere bounces off the beam's free end.
A piece of cloth falls and drapes over a box.
Create a rectangular piece of cloth pinned at its four corners. Let it sag under gravity, then release two corners and watch it swing down.
Simulate a cloth curtain hanging from a horizontal rod. A rigid sphere is thrown horizontally into the curtain, pushing it aside and passing through.
A blob of water falls into a shallow basin.
Simulate a stream of water pouring from above onto a slanted surface, letting it flow down and pool at the bottom.
Create a scene with a rigid sphere dropped from height into a container filled with water. The sphere should splash into the water and sink to the bottom while water splashes outward.
A pile of sand collapses and spreads on the ground.
Simulate sand particles being released from a container that tips over, causing the sand to pour out and form a pile on the ground.
Build an hourglass scene: sand fills the upper half and flows through a narrow opening into the lower half. Include glass walls so the sand stays contained.
Create a blue sphere on the ground.
Place a red metallic sphere and a yellow matte box next to each other on a gray ground plane. Both should have smooth, realistic-looking surfaces.
Load a robot arm from an MJCF file and give it a polished metallic appearance. Place a translucent red box on the ground in front of it with a slightly rough surface texture.
Set up a scene with a falling sphere and render it from a top-down view.
Create a scene with a red sphere falling onto a plane. Add a camera looking at the sphere from a 45-degree angle and record the simulation as a video.
Simulate a rigid box tumbling down a slope. Set up two cameras: one tracking the box from the side, and one from above. Record both views simultaneously as separate video files.
A rigid sphere is pushed sideways by a constant wind force while falling.
Create a scene where three rigid spheres are dropped from different heights. A strong upward force is applied only to the middle sphere, causing it to float while the others fall.
Simulate a rigid ball inside a box. Apply a rotating force field around the vertical axis so the ball rolls in a circular path along the bottom of the box.
Generate a hilly terrain and place a rigid sphere at the top of a hill to roll down.
Create a bumpy terrain with multiple peaks and valleys. Drop three rigid spheres at different locations and watch them roll into the valleys.
Generate a terrain with a steep cliff on one side and a gentle slope on the other. Simulate a rigid box sliding down the cliff and a sphere rolling down the slope simultaneously.
Spawn a drone hovering in place above the ground.
Create a drone that takes off from the ground, hovers at a height of 2 meters for a few seconds, then lands back down.
Simulate a drone flying a square path at constant altitude: move forward 3 meters, turn right, repeat four times to complete the loop, then land.
Attach a depth camera to a static sphere and render the depth map of the scene.
Place a robot arm on the ground and attach an IMU sensor to its end-effector. Move the arm and record the IMU readings during the motion.
Build a scene with a rotating rigid box on the ground. Mount a Lidar sensor on a fixed pole pointing at the box. Run the simulation and capture the point cloud data as the box rotates.
Load a robot arm and move its first joint to a 45-degree angle.
Load a Franka robot arm and command it to reach a target position in front of it. The end-effector should move smoothly from the home position to the target.
Load a robot arm with a gripper. Place a small rigid box on a table in front of it. Command the robot to pick up the box, lift it, and place it at a new location on the table.
A rigid sphere falls onto a soft elastic sheet stretched horizontally, causing the sheet to deform.
Simulate a robot arm pushing a rigid box off a table into a pool of water below. The box should splash into the water and sink.
Create a scene where sand pours from above onto a cloth sheet. The cloth sags under the weight of the accumulating sand.
